**Chinese name:** 芯原微电子（上海）股份有限公司 (Xīnyuán Wēidiànzǐ (Shànghǎi) Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded August 2001; the world's seventh-largest silicon IP vendor by one industry ranking (IPnest, 2023), and China's leading chip-design-service/IP-licensing firm — a different business model from every other entry in this tracker, since it designs chips for customers rather than selling its own branded product.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Licensable semiconductor IP blocks and full custom ASIC/SoC design services for other companies' chip products.
